caption: The drawing shows two objects set against a plain, light beige background. The first object, located near the top center, is a small, dark reddish-brown cup with a slightly flared rim. Around the upper exterior of the cup is a decorative band containing a pattern of red and yellowish green leaves. The second object, positioned below the cup, is a cylindrical container with a short, narrow neck. The body of this container is also dark brown, with horizontal decorative bands near the top and bottom. The upper band features a repeating pattern of red and green leaf-like forms above a row of yellow-green semicircles, while the bottom band includes a motif of elongated yellow-green ovals. Both objects cast soft shadows to their lower right, indicating the direction of the light source.
title: Toleware Tin Cannister
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
